name: One Way Window
source:
A short kinetic visual novel about reflecting and transgenderism, with added doses of mental illness and anime merch bribery.

It's also about your friend asking you if you want to create a visual novel within a month during midterm season and then vanishing without further elaboration when you respond.

[Edited from [url=https://iconoclastgirlfriend.itch.io/one-way-window]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于反思和变性的短篇动态视觉小说，增加了精神疾病和动漫商品贿赂的内容。

这也是关于你的朋友在期中期间问你是否想在一个月内创作一部视觉小说，然后当你回答时没有进一步说明就消失了。

[编辑自[url=https://iconoclastgirlfriend.itch.io/one-way-window]itch.io[/url]]
